record.name: Sapper
record.description: Sappers are military engineers who excel at battlefield construction, fortification, and tactical engineering. They build defenses, create obstacles, and use their engineering skills to support military operations.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Tactical engineers who build defenses and create obstacles to support military operations.

progression_tree.description: You become more skilled at building and fortifying defenses. Your proficiency bonus is added to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus when attempting to craft or repair structures, and you can add your proficiency bonus to the damage dealt by a structure you built or fortified.

effects.notes: As a sapper's precision improves, I instinctively fine-tune my systems to compensate for incoming attacks. My combat algorithms adjust in real-time, granting me +2 temporary hit points on successful blocks.

progression_tree.description: You become more skilled at planning demolitions. You can add your proficiency bonus to the damage dealt by a demolition you planned and executed.

effects.notes: Upon landing a hit, the sapper's explosives are triggered, inflicting 3 force damage to themselves and their target.

progression_tree.description: You become more skilled at reinforcing structures. When you take a short rest, you can add your proficiency bonus to the durability of any structure you built or fortified.

effects.notes: When the Sapper takes damage, they instinctively reinforce their structural integrity, granting them a +4 bonus to Armor Class until the start of their next turn.

progression_tree.description: You become more skilled at managing crisis situations. You can add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus when attempting to manage a crisis.

effects.notes: The sapper's mind works with frantic efficiency to mitigate damage. When they take a hit, their training kicks in and they gain +5 bonus to Armor Class for 1 minute.

progression_tree.description: You become the ultimate authority on battlefield control. You can add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus when attempting to control a battlefield.

effects.notes: The Sapper's mechanical arms rapidly reconfigure, generating a localized gravity wave that warps the battlefield around them. All projectiles and minions within 10 feet of the Sapper are slowed by 50% for 1 second.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a wide stance with legs shoulder-width apart, Sapper readies their blaster rifle while keeping a watchful eye on the surroundings.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue aura emanates from Sapper's suit, pulsing in sync with their life signs as they channel their tactical expertise into every action.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Depict Sapper in combat mode, standing amidst a ruined landscape with blaster rifle at the ready.
contextual_modifiers: Show the damage from recent battles on Sapper's suit
Emphasize the intensity of the environment with dramatic lighting
